name: twilio_sms_alert
description: Sends critical SMS alert notifications via the Twilio Programmable Messaging API for agent workflows.

message.description: SMS body text to send (max 1600 characters)

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). Reads TWILIO_TO_NUMBER if omitted.

from.description: Twilio sender phone number in E.164 format. Reads TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER if omitted.

account_sid.description: Twilio Account SID. Reads TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID if omitted.

auth_token.description: Twilio Auth Token. Reads TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN if omitted.
